items.exampleEn: The light switch is next to the door.
Can I have a tissue? My hands are wet.
items.exampleZh: 可以給我一張面紙嗎？我手濕了。

items.exampleEn: His shoes were covered in dirt after the hike.
items.exampleZh: 健行後他的鞋子沾滿了泥土。

items.exampleEn: We found shelter from the rain under a tree.
items.exampleZh: 我們在樹下找到躲雨的地方。

items.exampleEn: This phone has a lot of storage for photos.
items.exampleZh: 這支手機有很大的空間可以存照片。

items.exampleEn: The pipes in old buildings are often made of metal.
items.exampleZh: 老建築裡的水管常常是金屬做的。

items.exampleEn: Add some milk powder to the water.
This brick is heavier than it looks.
items.exampleZh: 這塊磚頭比看起來還重。

items.sentenceEn: Switch off the lights when you leave the room.
items.sentenceZh: 離開房間時請把燈關掉。

items.audioEn: There's not enough storage in this apartment, so we keep boxes under the bed.
items.audioZh: 這間公寓的收納空間不夠，所以我們把箱子放在床底下。

items.sentenceEn: The animal shelter is looking for kind people to help.
items.sentenceZh: 動物收容所正在找善心人士幫忙。

items.sentenceEn: Wash the dirt off the vegetables before cooking.
items.sentenceZh: 煮之前先把蔬菜上的泥土洗掉。

items.stemEn: The workers built the wall with red ____.
items.stemZh: 工人們用紅磚砌了這面牆。

items.stemEn: Water flows from the tank through a long ____.
items.stemZh: 水從水箱經過一條長長的管子流出來。

items.passageEn: My uncle is fixing up an old brick house in our neighborhood. Last week, he found a broken pipe under the kitchen floor, and there was dirt everywhere. He also moved all the light switches and built more storage under the stairs. The walls were covered in white powder from the work, so he covered his face with a cloth. He hopes to finish before winter, and then his family will move in.
items.passageZh: 我叔叔正在整修我們這一帶的一棟老磚房。上星期，他在廚房地板下發現一條破掉的水管，到處都是泥土。他也把所有電燈開關換了位置，還在樓梯下做了更多收納空間。牆上沾滿了施工留下的白色粉末，所以他用一塊布遮住臉。他希望在冬天前完工，到時候全家就會搬進去。

questions.questionZh: 叔叔在廚房地板下發現了什麼？
叔叔為什麼要用布遮住臉？

items.promptZh: 我的包包裡總是放著一包面紙。
referenceEn: I always keep a pack of tissues in my bag.
There is always a pack of tissues in my bag.
rubricZh: tissue 表示「面紙」，是可數名詞；「一包面紙」可寫，例如 a pack of tissues、a packet of tissues 等
說習慣多用現在簡單式，其他合理時態也接受

items.promptZh: 那間小房間現在被當作儲藏室。
referenceEn: That small room is now used for storage.
We now use that small room for storage.
rubricZh: 用 storage 表示「儲藏」（例如 is used for storage）
「被當作」可寫，例如 is used for、we use … for 等
